business_goal: Deliver the Task Search feature for the SaaS application.
scope: Implement search functionality for tasks by keyword in title or description
Display matching tasks as a list with links to task detail pages
Support real-time search as user types
out_of_scope: Search across multiple projects or workspaces
Search in task comments or tags
Full-text search with natural language processing

functional_requirements.description: Search tasks by keyword in their title or description, showing matching tasks as a list with links to each task's detail page.

non_functional_requirements.description: Search results should load within 2 seconds for up to 1000 tasks.
The search feature must support case-insensitive matching.

user_stories.goal: Find specific tasks quickly using keywords
user_stories.benefit: Save time and improve productivity by locating tasks without manual browsing

acceptance_criteria.description: When a user enters a keyword, matching tasks are displayed in a list with links to their detail pages.
Search is case-insensitive and returns results from both title and description fields.
Search results load within 2 seconds for up to 1000 tasks.

input_requirements: User enters a keyword in the search bar
Keyword can be a partial match in title or description
output_requirements: List of matching tasks with title and link to detail page
Display of zero results message when no matches found
ui_expectations: Search bar component at the top of the task list view
Auto-suggest or live search results as user types
Clear visual indication of matched tasks
api_expectations: API endpoint to handle search requests with keyword parameter
API returns structured JSON with task details and links
data_requirements: Task title and description fields must be indexed for search
Task ID and detail page URL must be included in search results

validation_rules.description: Search keyword must be at least 2 characters long to initiate search.

constraints: Search must be implemented using the MERN stack
No external search engines or services allowed
assumptions: Users will have access to task titles and descriptions in the database
Task detail pages are already implemented and accessible via URL
Search performance is acceptable for up to 1000 tasks
risks: Search performance degradation with large datasets
Inconsistent search behavior due to indexing issues
dependencies: Task listing API endpoint must be available
Task detail page routes must be defined

traceability.notes: Core functionality mapped to acceptance criteria
